source_name: MNB Fogyasztóvédelem — pénzügyi panasz útmutatók és eszkalációs útvonalak
why_relevant: Authoritative map of the Hungarian complaint escalation chain: provider complaint handling → MNB consumer-protection procedure → PBT → courts. Defines which body owns which dispute type, which is the prerequisite for correctly attributing and de-duplicating enforcement/complaint signals.

source_name: MNB Piacfelügyelet — Engedély nélküli, illetve bejelentés hiányában folytatott tevékenységek
why_relevant: Register of market-supervision findings and prohibitions against entities providing financial/payment services without a licence or notification. Directly identifies the unlicensed-PSP and pseudo-payment-service problem set the supervisor is currently chasing.

source_name: MNB Befektetői figyelmeztetések — hazai és külföldi hatósági figyelmeztetések (alk.mnb.hu figyelemsearch)
why_relevant: Consumer/investor warning database, split into domestic warnings and warnings relayed from peer supervisors. The paginated listing at alk.mnb.hu/figyelemsearch/listall (and its /en/ mirror) is a machine-harvestable list of named entities flagged for unauthorised financial, investment or payment services — a leading indicator of fraud typologies hitting Hungarian consumers.

source_name: MNB Intézménykereső (supervised-entity register)
why_relevant: Not an enforcement source itself, but the authoritative entity master-list needed to resolve institution names/licence types appearing in decisions, PBT cases and warnings — the join key for any enforcement dataset.

source_name: GVH — Versenyhivatali döntések (competition authority decision database)
why_relevant: Full-text database of Versenytanács decisions by year, including consumer-protection (misleading commercial practice) cases against banks and financial providers — e.g. a HUF 15m fine on CIB Bank Zrt. over misleading credit-card interest-free-period claims. Vj-numbered decisions are published as HTML and PDF with stable URL patterns, making this one of the most machine-friendly enforcement corpora in scope.

source_name: GVH Sajtószoba — sajtóközlemények
why_relevant: Announces which sectors the GVH is opening proceedings into — including, in 2026, an investigation targeting bank card terminal (POS) operator companies ('Bankkártya-terminál üzemeltető cégek a GVH célkeresztjében'). Directly on-cell for payments and an early-warning channel weeks-to-months ahead of formal decisions.

source_name: GVH — Versenyfelügyeleti eljárás (procedural rules and deadlines)
why_relevant: Defines procedural timelines (e.g. three-month decision deadline in unfair-commercial-practice cases, extendable twice by up to two months) and the határozat/végzés distinction — needed to forecast when an opened investigation should produce an outcome.

source_name: NAIH — Határozatok/Végzések (data protection authority decisions)
why_relevant: Published GDPR decisions and fines, including cases against financial-sector controllers (data breaches, unlawful processing in debt collection, transparency of privacy notices). NAIH orders publication where the breach affects a wide population, so the register skews toward the systemic cases that matter for bank/PSP data-handling risk.

source_name: Bírósági Határozatok Gyűjteménye (BHGY) — anonymised court decision collection
why_relevant: Statutory anonymised collection of Kúria, appellate-court and regional-court decisions on the merits, including administrative-law rulings reviewing single-instance administrative decisions — i.e. the judicial review of MNB and other regulator decisions. Full-text indexed search allows retrieval of cases where supervisory sanctions were upheld or overturned, which is the ground truth on how enforceable a supervisory position really is.

source_name: Kúria — anonimizált határozatok, jogegységi határozatok és Kúriai Döntések
source_subtype: supreme court decision and doctrine portal
why_relevant: Supreme Court layer: binding uniformity decisions (jogegységi határozat, e.g. the PJE line on FX-denominated consumer loans, most recently following CJEU C-630/23), joggyakorlat-elemző csoport analyses, press releases and the Kúriai Döntések periodical. These set the outer boundary of enforceable bank conduct in consumer contracts and are the single highest-impact litigation risk signal in HU retail banking.

source_name: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár (njt.hu)
source_subtype: official legal gazette / consolidated law database
why_relevant: Official consolidated law database; needed to resolve the legal bases cited in enforcement decisions (MNB rendeletek on payments and complaint handling, Hpt., Pft., Fttv.) and to date obligations and deadlines referenced in sanctions.

source_name: Jogászvilág (Wolters Kluwer) — Jogszabályfigyelő and enforcement commentary
why_relevant: Weekly 'Jogszabályfigyelő' legal-change column plus practitioner analysis of MNB measures — e.g. coverage of the new MNB complaint-handling regulation (16/2026. (VI. 3.) MNB rendelet, replacing the 2021 rules, in force from the second half of July 2026, affecting payment institutions, e-money issuers, loan servicers and crypto-asset service providers) and of Kúria uniformity decisions. Fast, dated, and flags deadlines a raw register does not surface.

source_name: Hungarian law-firm client alerts on financial enforcement (e.g. Maráczi, Fellegi & Társai)
why_relevant: Law-firm alerts interpret changes in sanctioning severity (e.g. sharply increased consumer-protection fine ceilings) and flag compliance deadlines earlier and more plainly than the regulators do. Treated as a class of source: several HU firms publish comparable banking/payments alerts.

source_name: GDPR.blog.hu — Hungarian data-protection enforcement blog
why_relevant: Tracks and interprets newly published NAIH fining decisions, including how the authority calibrates penalties (duration, systemic nature, number of data subjects). Useful for triaging which NAIH decisions in the financial sector are worth reading in full.

source_name: Hungarian financial trade press enforcement coverage (Portfolio / Privátbankár / Pénzcentrum / Adózóna / Piac&Profit)
why_relevant: Aggregates and contextualises enforcement outcomes (GVH fine totals, MNB sanctions, PBT usage, Kúria rulings) and often surfaces cases before the primary register is updated. Treat as a discovery/triage layer, never as the record of fact.

source_name: Regulated institutions' own publication of MNB decisions served on them
why_relevant: MNB decisions frequently oblige the sanctioned institution to publish the decision on its own website, sometimes in English translation (observed: Decision No. H-PM-I-B-3/2025 hosted by BNP Paribas Hungary). This is a secondary retrieval path for decision full texts, and the only easy route to English versions. It also lets you detect decisions by monitoring bank websites even if the central register lags.

source_name: NKFH — Társhatóságok (co-authority map) and general consumer-protection authority
why_relevant: Official map of which Hungarian authority handles which consumer complaint type, confirming that financial consumer-protection breaches route to the MNB rather than the general consumer-protection authority. Prevents mis-attribution when building the enforcement actor model, and identifies boundary cases (e.g. commercial practices of non-financial firms selling credit-adjacent products).

source_name: Pénzügyi Navigátor Tanácsadó Iroda hálózat (MNB-backed financial consumer advice network)
why_relevant: Front-line advisory network that sees consumer complaints before they reach the MNB or PBT; its guidance materials and published case themes reveal emerging retail pain points (payment fraud, complaint-handling failures) ahead of formal case statistics.

source_name: MNB English RSS feeds
why_relevant: English-language mirror of the MNB feed index; useful for cross-checking translation coverage and for items MNB publishes only in EN or only in HU (asymmetry itself is a signal of what is aimed at international market participants).

source_name: MNB Kiadványok – Archívum
why_relevant: Back-catalogue of MNB publications; gives historical depth for trend/baseline work that live feeds cannot supply.

source_name: MNB Felügyeleti szabályozó eszközök archívuma (incl. PSZÁF-era)
why_relevant: Archive of superseded supervisory instruments, including those issued by PSZÁF before its 2013-10-01 merger into MNB. Essential for reconstructing how a supervisory expectation evolved, and for spotting the pre-2013 institutional lineage that direct search misses.

source_name: MNB legacy supervisory web archive (mnb.hu/archivum/Felugyelet)
why_relevant: Frozen mirror of the old PSZÁF/supervisory site tree, organised by institution type (hitelintézetek, biztosítók, pénzügyi vállalkozások). A map of historical sources and terminology not reachable from the modern navigation.

source_name: MNB Adatszolgáltatói Portál – Adatszolgáltatási naptár (reporting deadline calendar)
why_relevant: An actual, structured DEADLINE TRACKER: the supervisory data-reporting calendar for Hungarian regulated institutions. Closest thing in HU to a native compliance-deadline feed; drives operational vendor/bank timelines. Companion pages list the full adatszolgáltatás catalogue.

source_name: MNB Európai szintű jogszabályok (EU-law gateway for HU supervised entities)
why_relevant: MNB's own curated map from EU-level acts (CRR/CRD, PSD2, MiCA, DORA etc.) into EUR-Lex, with the Hungarian-language versions. A ready-made crosswalk between the EU corpus and what the HU supervisor considers in scope.

source_name: EUR-Lex – Hungarian interface and My EUR-Lex RSS alerts
why_relevant: Authoritative Hungarian-language corpus of EU financial legislation plus a documented user-defined RSS alert facility (saved searches become feeds). Best mechanism for machine-readable horizon scanning of EU acts in HU, including national implementing-measure (NIM) records that reveal Hungarian transposition status and deadlines.

source_name: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár (njt.hu) – consolidated Hungarian legislation
why_relevant: Free official consolidated text repository of Hungarian law with time-state (időállapot) navigation — lets you see exactly what a rule said on a given date and when amendments bite. Holds Hpt. (2013. évi CCXXXVII. tv.) and the rest of the banking/payments statute base. Also fronts the Magyar Közlöny archive.

source_name: Magyar Közlöny (official gazette) – issue archive
why_relevant: Point of legal truth and the earliest possible signal: every Hungarian act, government decree, MNB decree and Hivatalos Értesítő notice appears here on publication day, typically before secondary coverage. Signed PDFs, searchable by date/issue.
